title: Edit tax rate: locked once invoiced, back on reversal, needs permission
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user. That role holds every permission, including Part sales -> Create & Edit and Invoicing & payments -> Create & Edit.
  2. A test customer exists. If not: Customers -> New Customer, enter a name (e.g. "4 Star Truck Repair") and save.
  3. A test vendor exists to order parts from. If not: Parts -> Vendors -> New Vendor, enter a Name (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Parts Supply"), then Save & Close.
  4. Start a new part sale today (a sale started before this release handles cores the old way): Parts -> Part Sales -> New Part Sale, then select the customer.
  5. On the Parts tab click Add Part: Description "Brake Pads", Quantity 1, Vendor = the test vendor, Sell Price $290.91. Save the row.
  6. Order and Receive that part (Actions column: Order, then Receive and confirm). Receiving every part takes the sale to Complete.
  7. Click Create Invoice. In New Customer Payment record a payment for the full balance (Payment Method e.g. "Cash") and save. Do not just close the dialog: closing it without paying cancels the invoice.
  8. Then, on the Finance tab, find that payment in the payment history and reverse it. The sale stays invoiced, with no payment applied.
  9. Two tax rates exist: Settings -> Taxes. If needed add one, e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST 6%" at 6.00%.
  10. Create the test role: Settings -> Roles & Permissions -> Create custom role -> choose a template (e.g. "Parts Manager") -> Apply; untick Part sales -> Create & Edit (leave Part sales View ticked); enter the Role name "ZZAUTOTEST No part sale edit" and click Create. Assign it: Settings -> Staff -> open a spare test user -> Edit Staff Member -> Role -> pick "ZZAUTOTEST No part sale edit" -> save. That user must log out and back in before testing (a role change ends their session).
custom_steps:
1. On the invoiced sale, open the Financial Info card and look for Edit tax rate.
  2. Reverse the invoice (the Reverse invoice action) and read the sale's status.
  3. On the Financial Info card, use Edit tax rate to pick the second tax rate (e.g. 6.00%) and save.
  4. Click Create Invoice again; on the new invoice read the tax rate, then look for Edit tax rate on the card.
  5. Sign in as the user without the permission, open a part sale, and look for the Edit tax rate control.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • On the invoiced sale the Financial Info card is read-only and Edit tax rate is not shown.
  • After reversing the invoice the sale is back to Complete and Edit tax rate is offered again; the new rate (e.g. 6.00%) saves.
  • The new invoice carries the rate that was set before it was created (e.g. 6.00%), and the card is read-only again.
  • A user without Part sales -> Create & Edit does not see Edit tax rate at all.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667 (Founder Mode Batch #1); story SV-10264 (Change the tax on a part sale); Part Sales Update v1 PRD (Confluence 867434569), Story 3; design canvas boards S3_*; read 5 Oct 2026 (specification edited that day). Source-verified 5 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-N1: “Once the part sale is invoiced or paid, the card is read-only and the action is not offered”
  • S3-N1: “Reversing the invoice unlocks it again, as on a work order: the reversal puts the sale back to Complete, and the card can be edited whenever the sale is not invoiced or paid”
  • S3-N1: “The next invoice locks the rate it carries then”
  • S3-N2: “A user without the permission above does not see the action”
